Date: 2027-06-24T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from today - stakeholder list and procurement path

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier - the demo was helpful for our team. I promised to pull together the high-level buying process and a list of folks I think need to be involved. Quick notes from our side:

- Economic buyer: likely Sarah Martin (CFO) - she wants a clear ROI case and cost cadence (monthly vs annual).
- Security/compliance: we'll need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a data flow diagram for the VPC option.
- Procurement: they route contracts through our legal team (legal@finovatebank.com) and then to procurement for T&C and PO.
- Timeline: procurement wants to have vendor paperwork ready by end of July; security review usually takes 2-3 weeks.

Can you send a short one-pager we can use to brief Sarah + a procurement checklist so I can kick off the procurement thread? Also - any pricing bands you can share for a dedicated capacity pilot? That'll help set expectations.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Integrations
Finovate Bank

P.S. cc'ing Procurement for visibility.

Alex - great to connect, thanks for the clear summary. Attaching: 1) procurement checklist (redwood-procurement-checklist.xlsx) and 2) a short pricing one-pager (redwood-MVP-pricing.pdf) with pilot options. High-level answers below and a proposed next steps list.

Quick answers:
- Pricing: pilot dedicated capacity (4 vGPU) - estimated $18k/month; hosted pilot (metered) - $6k-10k/month depending on token volume.
- ROI talk track: we typically lead with cost-per-inference comparison vs self-hosted (engineering + infra) and time-to-market gains (weeks vs months). I've included 3 bullet points you can use for Sarah.
- Security: Naomi will send SOC 2 and our data flow diagram; we support VPC/private deploy and can scope KMS/HSM options.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the economic buyer (Sarah) and the best intro cadence (email intro + 15min briefing or 30min).
2) Procurement/legal review the attached checklist; procurement tags any required redlines.
3) Naomi to share security artifacts (SOC 2 docs + architecture).
4) Rishi/NA to prepare a short ROI slide (2-3 bullets + simple TCO table) to share with Sarah.

If useful I can provide a short two-slide champion brief you can forward to Sarah (one slide: why Redwood, second slide: cost/benefit + pilot ask). Want me to send that now or after we hear back from procurement?

Thanks - Marissa
